## Summary

What changed and why? Link any related issue (for example, `Closes #123`).

## Type of contribution

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature or UX improvement
- [ ] Industry example or documentation
- [ ] Security, accessibility or maintenance

## How was this tested?

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Browser, keyboard and mobile checks where applicable (describe below)

## Community and trust checklist

- [ ] No secrets, private client data or personal information in this PR
- [ ] Changes to storage, Markdown/CSV or share links are backwards-compatible or documented
- [ ] External dependencies and third-party requests are justified and documented
- [ ] Documentation and accessibility impact considered
- [ ] New industry examples are illustrative and do not present unverified dates as facts
